messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] ravenwood-prod-vpc: sustained 429 spike on /generate (p95 1.2s, 429 rate 18%). paging on-call.
oncall-aaron: I'm on it. Investigating initial scope — which pool is serving Ravenwood? @platform-biff can you confirm?
platform-biff: Ravenwood is on vpc-dedicated-07 (GPU pool). Seeing 5xxs zero, just 429 quota throttles from rate-limiter. Tenant ID rwn-83. No recent deploys.
customer-ravenwood: Confirming, started seeing 429s ~10:05 PDT, hitting ~15% of requests failing. This is affecting webhook callbacks and ingestion.
eng-ops-maya: Can we temporarily increase their pool burst or attach a bypass for the next 30m? Suggest `redwoodctl pools burst --tenant rwn-83 --add 3000 --ttl 1800`
oncall-aaron: Don't run changes without accounting sign-off for enterprise. @acct-lina please advise on emergency override.
acct-lina: Ravenwood has enterprise contract with burst clauses. I can approve up to +5k tokens/min for 4h under emergency; need a ticket created and PO reference. I'll file E-2026 now.
acct-lina: (filed) E-2026 created, note: emergency burst approved by Lina. Customer billing will be adjusted per contract.
platform-biff: Running change now: ```bash
# temporary burst add
redwoodctl pools modify --tenant rwn-83 --burst-add 5000 --ttl 14400
``` 
platform-biff: change accepted by control plane :white_check_mark: seeing config propagate to vpc-dedicated-07.
sre-jaya: Watching metrics — 2m after change 429 rate down from 18% -> 2%, p95 latency stable. Need to check for noisy clients; request logs from customer for top endpoints.
customer-ravenwood: sending logs to S3 link: https://s3.redwood/ravenwood/2026-03-15/ingest.log (redacted). Mainly spikes from batch-worker cluster B.
prod-security: We must ensure audit trail. Platform, please attach the `--approval E-2026` to the change and record in audit. Also apply temporary token exemption instead of permanent change.
platform-biff: Attached approval and created a temp-exempt token: TOKEN-EXEMPT-RWN-83 (ttl 4h). Change recorded in audit log id audit-98765.
oncall-aaron: Good. Handing off to SRE for monitoring. @sre-jaya you own until stabilized and postmortem.
sre-jaya: Taking over. Will set alert threshold to 5% 429s and check cache/prefix KV usage. Will also coordinate rollback when stable.
eng-ops-maya: For follow-up: suggest adding per-route client-side backoff guidance and increasing small-burst headroom in dedicated pools for tiered contracts.
acct-lina: Customer notified and accepts emergency arrangement. Billing flagged for review.
customer-ravenwood: Thanks, system recovering. Please keep me posted if you need anything else.
prod-security: Closing security concerns — exemption token has tight TTL and audit log present. No credentials exposed.
oncall-aaron: Incident mitigated. Tracking ticket E-2026. Postmortem required (owner: sre-jaya). I'll update incident channel once postmortem is ready.
platform-biff: Metrics link: https://metrics.redwood/tenants/rwn-83/last24h shows recovery. :thumbsup:
sre-jaya: Will include root cause analysis (sharp ingestion bursts + insufficient request shaping on customer's side + headroom config). Planning an action: auto-burst for enterprise tiers with two-step approval.
oncall-aaron: Thanks everyone. Closing thread unless new regressions. :white_check_mark:
